# Template Lab

> Template Lab (templatelab.uk) sells practical digital templates — spreadsheets, calculators, business documents, cheat sheets and prompt packs — aimed at UK freelancers and small businesses. 72 products across 10 categories. Products are described exactly as they ship; none are purchasable yet ("Not yet on sale").

## Key pages

- [Home](https://templatelab.uk/): overview and featured templates
- [All templates](https://templatelab.uk/templates/): the full browse index
- [Machine-readable catalogue](https://templatelab.uk/catalogue.json): structured JSON of every product
- [Full catalogue as markdown](https://templatelab.uk/llms-full.txt): every product with its real file list
- [Terms](https://templatelab.uk/terms.html) · [Privacy](https://templatelab.uk/privacy.html)
